_why: The one switch for what the public site serves. "offline": true publishes only the plain notice (tools/site-notice.json), as /, /play/, /bench/, /band/ and 404.html, and copies nothing of the web export. To bring the playable site back: set "offline" to false AND "approved" to the date of Orb's word, with a recorded full-set pass of the pixel check for the commit (tools/flash/release-pass.json); build-site.mjs refuses to build the playable site otherwise. CI exports and checks the build either way. Orb's order, 2026-10-06. INTERIM (Orb's word 2026-10-14, Legal's interim terms): set "offline": false, "approved" to the date, and "interim": {"legal": "RL-<n>", "approved": "<date>", "expires": "<date>", "notice": "site-interim.json"} to build the playable site behind a click-through without a recorded full-set pass (docs/tools/site-interim.md); tools/check-site-interim.mjs gates it in CI. "interim": null is the full-set path above, unchanged.
